validation_protocol: Verify model_ready.candidate_site_view exists in Cloud SQL alfaloop-data-project:asia-east1:oday-dev-sql (POSTGRES_16)
Count eligible rows using the canonical definition: is_training_eligible IS True or eligible IS True
Verify interval_bounds_count > 0 so p80_coverage_ratio and interval_bounds_coverage_ratio are computable
Verify matched_prediction_count > 0 against governed predictions bound to model/version lineage
Assert no row satisfies y_pred = y_true (explicit anti-fallback probe)
Verify population alignment between the prediction source and the outcome population
Verify dataset snapshot id and SHA-256 against the Human/Ops attestation
Verify mature_population_digest is populated and reproducible
Verify named evidence owner and freshness/cutoff are recorded
Re-run the Gate 2 benchmark and assert measured_90d_mae is a real value, not null
Confirm ODP-PLAN-SITESCORE-PREDICTION-SOURCE-001 lineage receipt is merged before claiming Gate 2
fail_closed_conditions: prediction population not aligned with outcome population
dataset hash or mature population digest unverified
